quarantined.reason: real-device JSEngine parse failure: SyntaxError missing } after property list

notes: Test10 is a performance rebase. The hot release chain is reduced from nine layered patches to core + runtime + one performance runtime. Category hierarchy is persisted as compact JSON so category switching never re-fetches the homepage; recently visited category feeds use a bounded parsed-card cache. Detail pages are seed-first: list cards pass title/cover/desc so detail renders without any network request, while tags/recommendations become explicit on-demand expansion. Network hot paths use one 6.5s fetch budget and never perform automatic fetch->request or player-chain retries before rendering.
